hero.description: IWM caption : Lancaster B Mark II, DS652 'KO-B', of No. 115 Squadron RAF, undergoing a test of its Bristol Hercules VI sleeve-valved radial engines in a dispersal at East Wretham, Norfolk. DS652 failed to return from a raid on Bochum, Germany on 12/13 June 1943.

gallery.filename: 115 Squadron Lancaster Mark II missing rear turret 1943 IWM CE 79.jpg
gallery.title: File:115 Squadron Lancaster Mark II missing rear turret 1943 IWM CE 79.jpg
gallery.description: IWM caption : Back at their base, East Wretham, Norfolk, two members of the crew of Avro Lancaster B Mark II, DS669 'KO-L', of No. 115 Squadron RAF, examine the rear of their aircraft, where the rear turret, with its unfortunate gunner, was sheared off by bombs dropped from an aircraft flying above, during a raid on Cologne on the night of 28/29 June 1943.
categories: Air Ministry Second World War Official Collection

gallery.artist: Daventry B J (Mr), Royal Air Force official photographer
gallery.description: A bomber crew of No. 311 (Czechoslovak) Squadron RAF study a map, while sitting on 250-lb GP bombs which are about to be loaded into their Vickers Wellington Mark IC at East Wretham, Norfolk.
categories: Czechoslovak personnel in the RAF during the Battle of Britain
